import pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,os
root=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
cache=root/'.cache/generated.txt'
assert cache.resolve()==cache and not cache.is_symlink()
assert cache.read_bytes()==b'DISPOSABLE_GENERATED_CACHE\\n'
cache.unlink()
subprocess.run(['node','tools/build.mjs'],check=True)
assert cache.read_bytes()==b'DISPOSABLE_GENERATED_CACHE\\n'
cache.unlink()
print('PASS cache regeneration from absence; regenerated output removed')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ignore-check-',dir=root) as tmp:
    base=pathlib.Path(tmp)
    (base/'.gitignore').write_bytes((root/'.gitignore').read_bytes())
    hidden=['.env','.cache/generated.txt','.cache/deep/output.txt']
    visible=['.env.example','src/live.mjs','docs/current.md','.cache/example.example','.cache/deep/config.example','.cache/examples/config.json','.cache/examples/deep/config.json','other/.cache/generated.txt']
    for name in hidden+visible:
        p=base/name; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text('test\\n')
    result=subprocess.run(['rg','--files','--hidden','--no-require-git'],cwd=base,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
    found=set(result.stdout.splitlines())
    assert not set(hidden)&found,found
    assert set(visible)<=found,found

readme=(root/'README.md').read_text()
assert 'node tools/verify.mjs' in readme and '(docs/current.md)' in readme
assert (root/'docs/current.md').is_file()
print('PASS README command and local link')
subprocess.run(['node','tools/verify.mjs'],check=True)
PY"
